# What the strict model legs (ci.yml "Integration + e2e tests, fixtures
# mandatory", Linux arm64 and x86_64) are ALLOWED to skip. mk/run-tests.sh
# fails any skip not listed here (GEIST_EXPECTED_SKIPS), so a fixture that
# goes missing shows up as red instead of a quietly smaller suite. A test on
# this list that no longer skips is fine — remove it when its fixture lands.
# Taken from the 2026-09-25 green main run. One name per line.
